```sql
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.transaction_id) AS answer
FROM staging.stg_pos__transaction_lines t
JOIN staging.stg_erp__stores s ON t.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE s.store_name ILIKE '%Wellington%'
  AND t.txn_date >= '2025-08-01'
  AND t.txn_date <= '2025-08-31'
  AND t.txn_type = 'SALE'
  AND t.is_valid = TRUE;
```
